reconstruction_summary: V1 = KS yaw-rate with platform wheelbase L (Mach-E 2.984, F-150 Lightning 3.70) minus a per-segment yaw-gyro bias estimated from straight-line samples (|delta|<0.01) in that segment, exactly as in the agent's run_ladder.py.
notes: Reconstructed V1 = (v/L)*tan(delta) - per_segment_bias, with bias = mean of (ks_pred - meas) over rows with |delta|<0.01 in each segment; L=2.984 for Mach-E, L=3.70 for F-150 Lightning (from agent's parameters.py). Agent originally validated V1 only on 30 Mach-E segments; canonical run extends per-segment-bias logic identically to all 545 Ford segments.
